label: SYNTHETIC
description: Shared generator parameters for the rPPG synthetic pulse tests. Mirrored 1:1 by the static lets in Tests/RPPGTests/RPPGSyntheticSignal.swift (test_params_match_swift enforces it). Model: c_i(t) = I(t) * base_i * (1 + pulseRelAmplitude * w_i * p(t)) + noiseSigma * n_i; p(t) = (sin(2 pi f t) + h sin(4 pi f t + phi)) / (1 + h); I(t) = 1 + driftAmplitude * sin(2 pi driftFrequency t) + driftSlope * t. Timestamps t_k = k / fsNominal + jitter * (2u - 1). RNG: splitmix64 seeded with seedBase + bpm; per sample: one jitter uniform, then R, G, B normals (Box-Muller cosine branch, two uniforms each, u1 -> 1 - u1).
